From Data to Dicisions: Improving Clinical Insight Through Pediatric care

Posted by:

Anthony Martina

Medical researcher

Project description

This project explores how pediatric clinical datasets can be translated into clearer, more actionable insights for treatment decisions. The current phase focuses on identifying patterns in longitudinal patient data to improve diagnostic precision and reduce variabillity in care pathways. The aim is to bridge analytical findings with everyday clinical decision-making.
